Name: Lookup Anything
Author: Pathoschild
TagLine: See live info about whatever's under your cursor when you press F1. Learn a villager's favourite gifts, when a crop will be ready to harvest, how long a fence will last, why your farm animals are unhappy, and more.
Description:
See live info about whatever's under your cursor when you press `F1`. Learn a villager's favourite gifts, when a crop will be ready to harvest, how long a fence will last, why your farm animals are unhappy, and more ([see showcase](https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/tree/stable/LookupAnything#showcase)). Works on things in the world, your inventory, the calendar, game menus, shops, and more.

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/stable/LookupAnything/docs/screenshots/animated.gif)

**Translated into Chinese, English, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, and Spanish ([translations welcome](https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods#translating-the-mods)).**

![](https://i.imgur.com/suHzq2E.png)
1. [Install the latest version of SMAPI](https://smapi.io).
2. Install the mod through ModDrop (or unzip the download into `Stardew Valley/Mods`).
3. Run the game using SMAPI.

![](https://i.imgur.com/M7KlO44.png)
* Compatible with...
  * Stardew Valley 1.5 or later;
  * Linux, macOS, and Windows;
  * single-player and multiplayer (even if other players don't have it).
* No known mod conflicts.

![](https://i.imgur.com/j6fpZ3A.png)

Just press `F1` to view info about something under your cursor, or press `Left Shift` + `F1` to search. (You can [change to a different button](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Key_bindings). On laptops you may need to press `FN` and `F1` together.)

If there's no cursor (e.g. when playing with a controller or on mobile), the most relevant subject is shown instead. That may be something in front of the player, the player on the skills menu, the NPC on their profile page, etc.

[See the showcase page](https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/tree/stable/LookupAnything#showcase) for many examples and explanations of what the mod does. You can optionally [customise the mod settings](https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/tree/stable/LookupAnything#configure) (including button mappings and optional data mining fields).

![](https://i.imgur.com/ccJ4SPZ.png)
